ModMetaData.name: RJW-SexSlaveCraft
ModMetaData.author: Someone,Hajimi, TieJin
ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.5.0 (TieJin Modify) 原「调教」标签打开可拖动的六页管理窗口，随地图或殖民者栏的单选切换。 在「关系」页可为同一受训者追加、撤销、定位多名调教员，或逐人启用工作。旧单人指派会迁入名单。日常调教同一时间只接受一个任务。 新内容面向 RimWorld 1.7。1.6 使用 SSC 2.4.1。Harmony 和 RJW 先于 SSC，文化与仪式需要 Ideology。
The Training tab opens a movable six-page window that follows single selection on the map or colonist bar. Manage multiple trainers for each trainee in Relationships. Add, remove, locate, or enable work for individual trainers. Old single-trainer assignments migrate on load, and each trainee can have one active daily Training job. New content targets RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 component uses SSC 2.4.1. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC. Culture and rituals require Ideology.
[AI 辅助生成 / Partly AI-assisted]
